Initial release of md-to-slides.

- Converts Markdown into PowerPoint presentations (.pptx)
- Automatically splits slides using H1/H2 headings
- Preserves Markdown formatting (bold, italic, lists, tables, code blocks)
- Supports custom themes: professional, creative, minimal
- Accepts Markdown input directly or from file
- Provides simple CLI usage for quick conversions
